shouldTrigger: Build a shared vacation budget and split different expenses fairly among five people.
Compare low and high budget scenarios for our community event.
Create an editable spreadsheet showing who paid and what everyone owes.
shouldNotTrigger: Choose the best destination before we know the costs.
Research current hotel prices but do not build a budget yet.
Pay everyone back from my bank account.
expectations: Confirmed costs remain separate from estimates and assumptions.
The budget includes totals, contingency, split rules, and consistent rounding.
The result includes an editable spreadsheet and does not move money.
